description: M34 fuzz, shrunk repro of the speed runaway: constant throttle 0.378 + full left lock from 30 km/h, cargo24 on dry asphalt. The combination rolls over at t~4 s, all 10 wheels leave the ground, and the coupled bodies keep gaining speed (275 km/h at t=30 s) with the engine at idle (rpm 600, gear 1, amt state 0) - numerical energy injection while airborne.
expectedFailReason: Speed runaway past the 90 km/h limiter (275.4 km/h measured) and per-step dv spike 0.678 m/s during the airborne tumble; articulation also overshoots the 90 deg yaw stop by 2.23 deg. Suspected cause: the fifth-wheel constraint does work while the combination is tumbling with all wheels off the ground - game/Assets/_Project/Vehicle/Physics/Components/FifthWheel.cs:214-216 (Baumgarte-style bias term in lam = Kinv*(-(cdot + bias + P*gammaP))) and the one-sided soft yaw stop FifthWheel.cs:223/280-290 (penetration past yawLimitDeg). Found by fuzz seed 105 (hunt), shrunk to this 1-key timeline.
